item: A-004 follow-on: ooClickId/ooSetValue replaced by named handlers
summary: The two DOM helpers that clicked or filled a control by an id a binding supplied are gone, with their id sets. The three bindings that used them call named handlers that each touch one fixed field (annoImportPick, agendaSetTag, dumpReadSetTitle), so an injected binding has no call that fills any form field by id. No new user-visible string; behaviour of the three controls is unchanged.
